title: What Fortivex AI does
content: Fortivex AI describes itself as an AI and technology company building intelligent systems to help businesses operate, scale and evolve. Its website groups its work into Intelligent Systems, Business Automation, Product Engineering and Digital Transformation.

title: Directors and CEO

The sources reviewed do not explicitly verify who the CEO, founder, chairperson or managing director is. Do not identify either director as CEO without company confirmation.

title: Intelligent systems capabilities
content: The company website describes AI-powered systems intended to help organisations make better decisions and operate more intelligently. Listed focus areas include decision models, predictive systems and cognitive architecture.

title: Business automation capabilities
content: The company website describes business automation capabilities including automated document processing, intent extraction, smart approval workflows, cross-system automation, AI-agent orchestration, decision support and workflow intelligence.

title: Product engineering capabilities
content: The company website lists web platforms, mobile applications, SaaS systems, API architecture and cloud infrastructure as product engineering capabilities.

title: Digital transformation and integration
content: The company website lists enterprise systems, APIs, CRM, ERP and communication systems as areas for integration and digital transformation.

title: Project delivery approach
content: The company website describes a five-step delivery approach: Understand the problem and operating environment; Design the product, system and intelligence layer; Engineer scalable production-ready technology; Integrate it with existing business systems; and Evolve through continuous improvement, optimisation and scaling.

title: Fortivex CRM overview
content: Fortivex CRM is presented as an admissions and student-lifecycle CRM for educational institutes and education businesses. It brings lead capture, counsellor follow-ups, applications, admissions, batches, fees and placements into one AI-assisted system.

title: Fortivex CRM lead intelligence features
content: The Fortivex CRM website lists enquiry capture from web forms, WhatsApp, IndiaMART, JustDial, walk-ins and bulk uploads; automatic deduplication; lead assignment and distribution rules; segments and smart lists; and bulk upload with column mapping.

title: Fortivex CRM conversations and engagement
content: The product website lists a team inbox, lead inbox, WhatsApp broadcasts, AI chatbot qualification, automated messaging sequences, call logging and recordings, video-call scheduling, visit tracking and an engagement timeline.

title: Fortivex CRM student lifecycle features
content: The product website lists application-stage tracking, batch and trainer allocation, attendance and assessments, certificates and internships, placement tracking and alumni records.

title: Fortivex CRM fees, analytics and AI automation
content: The product website lists fee schedules, payments and quotes, collection reports, revenue analytics, workflow automation, AI summaries, AI lead scoring, smart follow-up nudges, automated reminders and SLA timers.

title: Fortivex CRM advertised integrations
content: The Fortivex CRM website lists integrations including WhatsApp Business, Meta Lead Ads, Google Ads, IndiaMART, JustDial, website forms, Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Razorpay, Tally, Zoom, Google Sheets, Truecaller, SMS gateways, Zapier, REST API and webhooks. The advertised list does not establish that every integration is enabled for every customer or plan.
qualification: Advertised product integrations; confirm availability and configuration for a specific customer.

title: Fortivex CRM published pricing
content: The product website displays annual-billing prices of ₹999 per user per month for Starter (up to 5 users), ₹1,999 per user per month for Growth (up to 50 users), and custom pricing for Enterprise. The page says monthly billing is 20% higher. It advertises a 14-day free trial. Confirm current pricing and terms before quoting.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.user_limit: Unlimited users and campuses, as advertised

qualification: Website-published pricing; verify live commercial terms before making an offer.

title: Fortivex CRM implementation timelines
content: The Fortivex CRM website says most single-campus institutes can go live within 48 hours. It says multi-campus rollouts with custom workflows typically take two to three weeks. These are website-stated typical timelines, not a guarantee for every deployment.

facts.single_campus: Website says most can go live within 48 hours

qualification: Typical website-stated timelines; confirm project-specific timeline.

title: FAMS overview
content: The product website expands FAMS as Financial & Attendance Management System. It presents FAMS as a workforce, attendance, leave, payroll and HR operations platform for educational institutions, academies, training centres, businesses and organisations.

title: FAMS features
content: The FAMS website lists daily attendance registers, late and absence flags, department-wise reports, attendance dashboards and trends, leave requests and approvals, leave balances, shift and roster planning, attendance-linked payroll runs, reimbursement claims, payslip records, recruitment pipeline, candidate stages, employee onboarding, performance reviews, project and task tracking, reports, secure authentication and role-based access.

title: FAMS pricing
content: The FAMS website does not display fixed numeric prices. It says plans are quoted per organisation based on selected modules and the number of people managed. The page lists Starter, Professional and Enterprise plans as 'On request'.

facts.pricing_basis: Selected modules and number of people managed

title: What does Fortivex AI do?
content: Fortivex AI is an AI and technology company based in Bengaluru. Its website describes work across intelligent systems, business automation, product engineering and digital transformation. It also presents an ecosystem that includes Fortivex CRM, FAMS, Empowers Academy and Medivex AI.

title: Who is the CEO of Fortivex AI?
content: The CEO's name is not verified in the public sources reviewed. A public company-information listing names two directors but does not establish either person's CEO title. The assistant must not guess. Offer to have the Fortivex team confirm the correct leadership information.

title: How can I contact Fortivex AI?
content: The official contact page publishes contact@fortivexaitech.com and +91 8151876077.

title: Can Fortivex build a custom solution?
content: The company website describes capabilities in intelligent systems, business automation, product engineering and digital transformation. A specific project's scope, feasibility, timeline and pricing require discussion and confirmation by the Fortivex team.

title: Can I book a meeting with Fortivex?
content: The assistant may collect the caller's name, organisation, email address and preferred date or time, with consent. It must check the team's actual calendar availability and only say that the meeting is booked after the calendar system confirms successful creation.

title: Answer only from verified knowledge
content: Answer factual questions using retrieved knowledge-base content. Do not invent company facts, executive names, product capabilities, pricing, customer references, implementation commitments or performance claims. If the requested fact is not present or cannot be confidently supported, say: 'I don't have verified information about that yet. I can arrange for the Fortivex team to follow up.'

title: Distinguish company, product and ecosystem brands
content: Keep Fortivex AI Private Limited, Fortivex CRM, FAMS, Empowers Academy and Medivex AI as distinct entities. Do not attribute a product feature to another product or imply that an ecosystem brand is a standalone software product of the parent company. Describe brand relationships only as stated in their official sources.

title: Pricing and commercial commitments
content: Treat website prices as published snapshots, not live quotes. Confirm current prices, plan eligibility, taxes, discounts, custom quotations, availability, implementation scope and commercial terms with an authorised Fortivex representative before making a binding commitment.

title: Appointment booking and lead storage
content: RAG provides knowledge; it does not perform external actions. Use backend tools for lead creation, calendar availability checks, appointment booking and call-summary storage. Obtain caller consent before storing personal information. Never claim a lead was saved or an appointment was booked until the corresponding backend action confirms success.

title: Lead data collection
content: Collect only information necessary for the requested follow-up and explain why it is being collected. Ask for consent before storing contact information or using it for follow-up. Do not infer budget, authority, company size or purchase intent from a caller's accent, voice or demographic characteristics.
